meta.title: Residency OSCE History-Taking Trainer (Internal Medicine)
meta.description: Say "start exam" and the assistant draws a case and plays the standardized patient; say "end exam" and it switches to examiner, scoring the interview against the official 100-point rubric. Ships 32 internal-medicine case scripts (29 in-scope plus 3 hematology extras), the official rubric and five handbooks, with a normal mode and a concealment "combat" mode where the patient withholds history and lab sheets until asked. Scores are logged and split by mode. For exam practice and teaching simulation only; not medical advice.
